description: I'm passionate about AI, Data Science, and space exploration. I want to work on NASA's Flame in Freefall challenge by building an AI-powered dashboard that turns microgravity combustion data into useful fire-safety insights. I bring experience in Python, data analysis, and machine learning. I'm looking for teammates skilled in AI/ML, data engineering, web development, or UI/UX who are curious, collaborative, and excited to build something meaningful.
